key_insight: LCatlas is a web-based tool that uses routinely available patient data to predict first-line immunotherapy outcomes in non-small cell lung cancer, rather than discover new drugs.
clinical_relevance: The tool could support research-informed assessment of immunotherapy outcomes, but its reported performance does not establish readiness to guide treatment decisions.
method: Used demographic, clinical, and molecular data from 79 patients receiving first-line immunotherapy.
Compared logistic regression, XGBoost, and TabTransformer prediction approaches.
Accepts nine reported input categories to predict outcomes with immunotherapy alone or combined with chemotherapy.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports cross-validation AUC of 0.79 (0.72–0.85), sensitivity of 87%, specificity of 78%, and 82% accuracy in a 28-person validation cohort.
watch_item: Small development and validation cohorts limit confidence in generalizability; larger prospective evaluations are needed before clinical implementation.
paper_title: LCatlas: A Point-Of-Care Tool for Predicting Immunotherapy Outcomes in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
